title: Fourth integrability of monomials
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be mutually independent real random variables in $L^4$. For every subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the monomial $\prod_{i\in S}X_i$ belongs to $L^4$.
hypotheses_covered: the random variables are mutually independent
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
replaced: Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be mutually independent real random variables on a probability space, each in $L^4$. Every monomial $\prod_{i\in S}X_i$, $S\subseteq[n]$, belongs to $L^4$.
